research_question: Does bounded source-page context improve NFCorpus first-stage retrieval without changing the corpus, judgments, retriever, reranker, or architecture?

official_nfcorpus_v1.note: The ir_datasets 0.6.1 metadata points to an obsolete URL. Use the current official download URL and retain the published integrity check.

cohort.name: official_test_video
cohort.qid_sha256_canonicalization: UTF-8 encoding of lexicographically sorted qids, one qid plus newline per record.
cohort.official_query_records_sha256_canonicali: UTF-8 JSON Lines ordered by qid; each compact sorted-key record contains qid, title, and description, followed by newline.
cohort.membership_rule: Exact qid intersection with nfcorpus/test/video; no outcome-based query selection.

title.construction: Normalize Unicode and collapse whitespace only.

description.construction: Normalize Unicode and collapse whitespace only.

title_plus_description.source: BEIR query text plus official NFCorpus video description
title_plus_description.construction: Normalize each field, join with one newline, then collapse repeated whitespace within each field.

excluded_conditions.official_all_fields: Not a primary treatment: median 192 words, 136 of 323 shared queries exceed 512 words, and the field contains full source-page content connected to qrel construction.
excluded_conditions.live_page_scraping: Not reproducible against the 2015 crawl and may introduce temporal drift.
excluded_conditions.qrel_or_document_conditioning: No qrel, relevant document, ranked document, or metric result may be read while constructing query text.

fixed_system.retriever: Existing project BM25 implementation and parameters
fixed_system.corpus: BEIR NFCorpus corpus from the pinned source archive
fixed_system.index_policy: Reuse one corpus index across all query representations
fixed_system.ranking_tie_break: Retrieve the full 3,633-document corpus, then sort by score descending and doc_id ascending before top-k truncation.

evaluation.reranker_boundary: Recall@1000 is omitted for top-100 reranked runs.

acceptance_checks: The deterministic title condition reproduces every recorded metric within 1e-12.
Published fixed-run deltas and positive-score recall are retained as diagnostics, not cross-platform acceptance guards.
All three conditions contain the same 102 qids exactly once.
The corpus, qrels, BM25 parameters, and index fingerprint are identical across conditions.
Each reranked run contains exactly the corresponding BM25 top-100 candidate set per qid.
Query construction succeeds without loading qrels, corpus documents, ranked outputs, or metrics.
All scores are finite and run ranks are contiguous with no duplicate docids.

decision_rule.representation_effect: Report the paired Recall@100 delta and the change from 11 title-condition no-hit-at-100 queries; do not infer causality from aggregate MRR alone.
decision_rule.architecture_gate: Do not test hybrid or dense retrieval unless a material candidate-set limitation remains after the best bounded representation.
decision_rule.publication_boundary: Do not update README headline claims until complete runs, independent metric cross-checks, review, and CI are finished.
